t: Debarim haasurim laasot beshabbat leor hanner
s: Debarim haasurim laasot beshabbat leor hanner ubo y"g seipim: asur lehishtammesh leor hanner beshabbat kol dabar shetztzarik iyyun harbeh, kegon liplot begadayv, o libdoq tzitzit, o liqrot basseper leor hanner shel shemen, vaapillu im eno motzi bepiv mah shehu qore, gezera shemma yishkach veyatteh hanner leqareb hashshemen el happetila kede shettidlaq yoter yapeh, veyitchayyeb mishshum mabir. Abal bener shel shaava o shel cheleb hakkaruk sebib happetila, sheen derek lehattoto keshehappetila hi keshera (ayyen simman rs"d) — yesh mattirim. Veyesh oserim, gezera shemma yimchot rosh happetila, veyesh bezeh mishshum mekabbeh. Uleet hatztzorek yesh lismok al sebara harishona:

Apillu im hanner qabua bachor shebbakkotel sheeno yakol lehattoto, vaapillu hu gaboah eser qomot sheeno yakol ligga elayv kelal, vaapillu hu sagur baashashit — asur bekol inyan, shello chillequ chakamim baddabar, shehanner sheaseru lehishtammesh leoro tashmish shetztzarik iyyun — asaruhu bekol inyan:

Umikkol maqom, lo aseru ella leadam echad bilbad, abal shenayim qorin beyachad, sheim yabo haechad lehattot yazkirennu chabero. Vehu sheqqorin beinyan echad, sheaz mashgiach haechad bemah shechabero oseh, abal im zeh qore beinyan zeh vezeh qore beinyan zeh, ap al pi sheshshene hainyanim hem bedap echad — hare kol echad veechad tarud beinyano veen mashgiach bemaaseh chabero, ulepikak asurim liqrot. Vaapillu kesheqqorin inyan echad ella shezzeh qorehu beseper echad vezeh qorehu beseper acher — hare kol echad tarud besipro veeno mashgiach bemaaseh chabero, ulekak asurim liqrot. Velaken asur lomar piyyutim bebet hakkeneset belele yom tob shechal lihyot beshabbat, lepi shekkol echad qore missipro. Veyesh omerim sheen chilluq ben seper echad lisparim harbeh, kol sheqqorin beinyan echad — muttar. Vehamminhag kassebara harishona:

Harotzeh liqrot veomer leacher sheimmo sheeno qore "ten dateka alay shello atteh hanner" — hare zeh muttar liqrot. Vehu haddin im omer ken leishto, ap al pi sheddatah qeroba etzlo — lo tannichehu lehattot. Veken im mapleh et begadayv vehi meshammarto shello yatteh — hare zeh muttar. Abal im hi o acher gam ken mapleh immo — asur, shehare kol echad bodeq bemaqom acher, vekol echad tarud bibdiqato veeno mashgiach bemaaseh chabero:
Adam chashub shebbarur lo sheen darko lehattot hanner beatzmo kol yemot hachol — muttar lo liqrot beshabbat, vaapillu yechidi veen acher meshammero:

Lo hittiru lishnayim sheyyiqreu beinyan echad apillu beseper echad ella leor hanner, abal etzel hammedura apillu asara keechad en qorin, shemmittok shezzanbot haudim semukim lahem — yukal echad lachtot bahem beqal ubimhirut kol kak qodem sheyyargish bo chabero, umah yoil sheyyazkirennu chabero achar shechata kebar. (Umittaam zeh ap keshemmitchammemim etzlah lo yeshebu besamuk lezanbot haudim):
Tinoq[o]t shel bet rabban qorin leor hanner apillu shello bipne rabban, mippene sheemat rabban alehen, veen poshetin yad leshum dabar ap bechol ella al pi rabban, ulepikak lo yabou lehattot:
Muttar liqrot pereq "bammeh madliqin" leor hanner, shehare hu mazkir issur shabbat veek yishkach veyatteh:
Nohagim liqrot belel yom hakkippurim bemachzorim, mippene sheemat yom hakkippurim alehem velo yattu:

Harab yakol lirot leor hanner mehekan yiqreu hattinoqot, ulesadder rashe happarashiyyot bepiv mittok hasseper leor hanner, vehashshear qore beal peh lesayyea et hattinoqot. Velo rashe parashiyyot bilbad, ella kol sheyyodea qetzat happarasha beal peh ubiqtzat tzarik lirot basseper apillu beemtza happarasha — hare zeh muttar, shemmeachar sheeno meayyen basseper tamid — yesh lo hekker bazeh velo yabo lishkoach ulehattot. Lepikak, lel pesach shechal lihyot beshabbat — muttar liqrot hahaggada basseper leor hanner, lepi sheen am haaretz shello tehe shegura bepiv qetzat, veeno tzarik leayyen basseper ella lipraqim. (Veap kesheqqore kullah basseper — muttar, kevan sheeno tzarik lazeh). Vehu haddin hazzemirot sheomerim bekol shabbat al hashshulchan, mishsheyyargil bahen qetzat beal peh — yakol leomran mittok hasseper. Vekol shekken shehammashkim beshabbat lebet hakkeneset — mitpallel sham leor hanner haddoleq mibbeod yom, shezzehu muttar, shehattepilla ushear debarim shehu ragil leomram hem shegurim bepiv yoter mehahaggada. Abal lilmod asur apillu hu yom, im hacheder apel adayin beinyan shetztzarik lener:

Kelim haddomin zeh lazeh vetzarik iyyun rab lehabchin (ben zeh lazeh) benehem — asur lebodqan leor hanner. Vaapillu lehabchin ben begadayv lebigde ishto asur im hem domim zeh lezeh. Abal mistakkel hu mah shebbekos umah shebbiqara leor hanner, shehittiru lo mippene hanneqiyyut umippene hassakkana. Vehu haddin libror yaraq, haokel mittok happesolet, veken kol kayyotze bazeh:

Shammash sheeno qabua asur lo libdoq kosot o qearot haddomin ulehabchin benehem leor hanner, mippene sheeno makkiran vetzarik hu leayyen bahem harbeh ad sheyyabchin benehem, veshemma yishkach veyatteh. Abal hashshammash haqqabua, hoil umakkiran — eno tzarik iyyun harbeh lehabchin benehem, lepikak im ba libdoq — en moneim oto. Abal en morin lo lekattechilla libdoq ap al pi shehu muttar, dekevan shemmeqareb yadayv lanner lehabchin benehem — chosheshim shemma yistappeq mehashshemen shebbanner. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bener shel shemen, abal ner shel nept kevan shehu maus — en chosheshim sheyyistappeq mimmennu, umorin lo lekattechilla. Veyesh omerim shebbener shel nept apillu shammash sheeno qabua muttar libdoq leoro, mippene sheoro rab velo yitztarek lehattot. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim:
Nahagu lekassot haqqetannim shello yihyu arummim bipne hannerot, mishshum bizzuy mitzva (vegam bechol yesh sakkana laamod bipne hanner arom):
